prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If task object is visible, approach it, take it, move it, do a task and return it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabTaskObject    /> <Action ID = MoveTaskObjectToDesignatedLocation    /> <Action ID = TakeTaskObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachTaskObject    /> <Action ID = ReturnTaskObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForTaskObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessTask    /> <Condition ID = IsTaskSuccessful    /> <Condition ID = IsTaskObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsTaskComplete    /> <Condition ID = IsTaskObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsTaskComplete? THEN
			DO GrabTaskObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessTask
			IF IsTaskSuccessful? THEN
			DO ReturnTaskObject
	END
